highlights: close proximity to the vibrant quayside
well established residential area with communal gardens
summary: Perfectly positioned within close proximity to the vibrant Quayside and Newcastle city centre, this exceptional top-floor apartment offers an enviable combination of stylish contemporary living, impressive space, and one of the region’s most desirable locations.
description:
Situated within the heart of a well-established residential setting, the development enjoys a peaceful atmosphere while remaining just moments from the energy and culture of the Quayside. Renowned for its cosmopolitan lifestyle, the Quayside stretches beautifully along the River Tyne and is home to an outstanding selection of fashionable bars, award-winning restaurants, cafés, and nightlife venues. Residents can also enjoy the popular Sunday Quayside Market, offering artisan produce, local crafts, and street food, while iconic landmarks including the Gateshead Millennium Bridge, the renowned Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art, and The Glasshouse International Centre for Music further enhance the area's appeal and cultural significance. The apartment itself is surrounded by similar high-quality residential properties and benefits from attractively maintained communal grounds featuring established trees and shrubbery, creating a welcoming and attractive environment with a sense of privacy and tranquillity rarely found so close to the city centre. Accessed via a secure communal entrance with lift access serving all floors, the apartment occupies a desirable top-floor position, offering an elevated sense of privacy along with a light-filled and spacious interior. Upon entering, the welcoming hallway immediately highlights the unique and thoughtfully designed layout of the home, with stairs leading to an impressive mezzanine-level principal bedroom suite. The mezzanine accommodation creates a striking feature within the property, comprising a spacious bedroom area, dedicated dressing space, and private en-suite facilities, providing a luxurious retreat separate from the main living accommodation. To the main floor, the apartment continues to impress with a beautifully presented open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area designed perfectly for modern living and entertaining. Flooded with natural light, this expansive space offers a bright and airy atmosphere throughout, while direct access to a private balcony provides the ideal spot for outdoor seating, morning coffee, or evening relaxation. The property further benefits from two additional well-proportioned bedrooms along with a contemporary family bathroom, offering flexible accommodation suited to a wide range of buyers including professionals, downsizers, first-time purchasers, or investors seeking a prime city-fringe opportunity. Immaculately presented throughout and offered to the market with no onward chain, this superb apartment successfully combines modern style, versatile living space, and an outstanding location close to the very best that Newcastle and Gateshead have to offer. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the impressive layout, generous accommodation, and exceptional lifestyle opportunity presented by this stunning home.

ENTRANCE HALL The welcoming entrance hall creates an impressive first impression and provides access to the principal accommodation throughout the apartment. The space benefits from an electric heater for added comfort and features a useful built-in storage cupboard incorporating plumbing for an automatic washing machine, offering excellent practicality and additional storage solutions. A staircase rises from the hallway to the stunning mezzanine-level bedroom suite, further enhancing the apartment's unique and contemporary layout.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING / KITCHEN The impressive open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area forms the true heart of the home, offering a superbly spacious and versatile living environment. Beautifully proportioned, this contemporary space is flooded with natural light, enhanced by large windows, French doors opening directly onto the balcony, and an additional Juliette balcony, all of which combine to create a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the day. The lounge and dining area provides ample room for both relaxing and entertaining, with generous proportions allowing for a full dining table and seating arrangement, making it ideal for modern lifestyles and social gatherings. Two electric heaters ensure year-round comfort while maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic. The kitchen is stylishly fitted with a range of contemporary base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and contrasting splashbacks for a sleek and coordinated finish. An inset sink unit with mixer tap is positioned beneath the worktop, while integrated appliances include an oven, hob, stainless steel chimney-style extractor, and dishwasher, all thoughtfully designed to maximise both functionality and visual appeal within this exceptional open-plan space.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a well-proportioned and spacious double room, offering a comfortable and versatile living space. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows for plenty of natural light to filter through, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The room is further enhanced by an electric heater, ensuring a comfortable temperature throughout the year while maintaining a clean and modern finish.

BEDROOM THREE Bedroom Three is another generously sized and versatile room, well-suited as a double bedroom, guest room, or home office if required. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows natural light to fill the space, creating a bright and pleasant environment. The room also benefits from a radiator, providing efficient heating and ensuring year-round comfort.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite, thoughtfully designed to create a clean and contemporary finish. The suite comprises a spacious double shower cubicle with an inset mains-fed shower, a wash hand basin, and a WC, all arranged to provide both style and practicality. The room benefits from tiling to the splash and vanity areas, adding a sleek and easy-to-maintain surface while enhancing the overall modern feel. An electric heater provides additional comfort, ensuring the space remains warm and inviting throughout the year.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

The first-floor landing serves as a central point of access within the apartment, providing a smooth transition to the mezzanine-level accommodation. From here, there is direct access to the impressive master bedroom suite, enhancing the property's unique and well-considered layout.

MASTER BEDROOM The mezzanine bedroom is a truly impressive and generously proportioned double room, forming a striking feature within the apartment. This unique space benefits from sliding patio doors opening directly onto the external balcony, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living and allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the room. A glass and wood balustrade overlooks the main living area below, enhancing the sense of openness and architectural interest while adding a stylish contemporary finish. The room is comfortably heated via an electric heater and is further enhanced by excellent built-in storage, including two fitted cupboards providing robes, shelving, and hanging space, ensuring both practicality and organisation. From the mezzanine bedroom, there is access to a dedicated dressing area and private en-suite facilities, completing this superb and well-appointed principal suite.

DRESSING ROOM The dressing area is a well-proportioned and practical space, offering excellent room for freestanding furniture as well as dedicated hanging space for clothing. There is ample provision for a dressing table, creating an ideal area for getting ready while maintaining a sense of organisation and separation from the main bedroom suite. The space continues the light and airy feel of the mezzanine level, enhancing the overall sense of luxury and functionality within the principal accommodation.

EN SUITE The en-suite is fitted with a modern white suite, designed to offer both style and practicality. The accommodation comprises a shower cubicle with an inset mains-fed shower, a wash hand basin, and a WC, all presented in a clean and contemporary finish. The space benefits from tiling to the splashback and vanity areas, enhancing both the aesthetic appeal and ease of maintenance. An electric heater provides additional comfort, ensuring the room remains warm and inviting throughout the year.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property is set within well-maintained communal gardens, thoughtfully landscaped with established trees and attractive shrubbery, creating a pleasant and peaceful outdoor environment. The grounds are carefully presented, offering a sense of greenery and tranquillity that complements the apartment's modern living space. In addition, the property benefits from an allocated car parking space, providing convenient and secure off-road parking for residents
